version.description:
Teak is your personal vault for design inspiration and creative ideas. Save, organize, and access your creative vision on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.

CAPTURE ANYTHING
• Save links, images, videos, audio notes, and documents
• Capture content directly from other apps via Share extension
• Capture content directly from web pages with the Safari extension
• Record voice memos on the go

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
• Create custom cards for each inspiration or idea
• Add notes and tags to keep everything searchable
• Mark favorites for quick access to your best ideas
• Search instantly across all your content

SYNC EVERYWHERE
• Access your vault on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web
• Content stays in sync automatically across all devices

ON YOUR MAC
• Save from the menu bar or with the Quick Capture shortcut
• Save the page you're reading with the Safari extension

YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
• Private by design - your content is never used for advertising
• Industry-standard encryption protects your data
• Export or delete your data anytime
• 30-day recovery period for deleted items

TEAK IS FOR
• Designers collecting inspiration
• Creators organizing ideas and references
• Researchers saving articles and resources
• Anyone building a personal knowledge base
version.promotionalText: Capture, organize, and access your creative inspiration anywhere.
version.whatsNew: Teak is now a native app for iPhone and iPad. Save from the share sheet without opening Teak, save pages with the new Safari extension, and browse your library in a layout made for iPad.
